conviction_note: The event is Convatec's scheduled trading update for the 10 months to 31 October 2026. Last year's equivalent update carried the first guide for the next year (FY26), so this one most likely carries the first FY27 framing, and abs_move is sized on the guidance scale (7.5). The one material sourced lean is negative: the company qualified its 2027 mid-20s margin target 'at prevailing price levels' and flagged $20-30m of 2027 cost pressure in May. Brent then averaged $124 in October (EIA), Convatec forward-buys 6-12 months, and Coloplast (2 Nov) flagged raw-material and freight inflation plus FY26/27 gross-margin pressure. Against that: both prior November updates rose (+22.1%, +5.1%), the end markets look healthy at Coloplast and MiniMed, and 4.3% of shares are steadily short. So p_up is 45, not lower. The findings sum (-1.2) and the scaled number (-0.75) agree in sign. The scaled number is smaller because the strongest finding is a macro-to-company inference on a name 19 analysts cover, and they can model oil themselves.

findings.finding: Input-cost risk to the first FY27 margin framing. Convatec qualified its 2027 mid-20s margin target 'at prevailing price levels', forward-buys materials 6-12 months ahead, and in May quantified $20-30m of 2027 cost pressure (6% inflation against 3% planned). EIA then put Brent at $124 in October 2026, up $10 on September, the highest since July 2022. So the FY27 margin message given in this update is more likely to be qualified or softened than raised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First next-year guides in November updates: Nov 2025 (FY26 double-digit EPS, margin expansion) +5.07%; Nov 2024 +22.07%. The May 2026 update, which carried the 2027 cost warning and weak organic growth, fell 4.95% (as much as 8% intraday).
findings.original_quote: We are also on track to deliver our medium-term margin target of mid-20s by 2027 at prevailing price levels. ... we forward-purchase materials, typically for 6-12 months.
findings.why_not_priced: Oil is public, but the company has not yet said what FY27 margin it will frame; that line is new in this release. The stock rose about 21% from 8 Oct into the print, while Brent was at its highs, on defensive rotation, and the short register is flat rather than building. Neither looks like a market positioned for a softer margin message. Partly priced: 19 analysts can model resin costs, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Coloplast FY25/26 release (2 Nov 2026): Q4 EBIT hit by 'inflationary pressure on raw materials and freight', and it expects FY26/27 gross-margin pressure from inflation (https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/coloplast-as-announcement-no-112026-202526-full-year-financial-results). EIA November STEO via OilMonster, 2026-11-12: 'Brent crude averaged $124 per barrel in October' (https://www.oilmonster.com/article/eia-raises-2026-brent-oil-forecast-to-9744-a-barrel/8787). The CEO's May warning is Reuters via WHBL, 2026-05-21 (https://whbl.com/2026/05/21/medical-product-maker-convatec-warns-of-higher-cost-from-iran-war/).

findings.finding: Coloplast, the nearest listed ostomy/continence peer, reported Q4 (Jul-Sep 2026) organic growth of 6% in Ostomy Care and 5% in Continence Care on 2 Nov. That points to healthy end markets for Convatec's OC and CC categories in the period this update covers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Organic growth surprises move this name: the May 2026 organic miss fell 4.95%, and the Nov 2025 update (YTD 6.3% ex-IM) rose 5.07%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a peer read-through, public for two weeks, and the market already expects H2 acceleration. It sits inside Convatec's guided H2 6-8%, so it is sized toward 0.

findings.finding: Smith+Nephew Q3 2026: Advanced Wound Care +1.4%, total AWM -0.2% underlying, and a cut to FY guidance. The wound care market is still slow, which caps the upside in Convatec's AWC category (H1 +3.4% ex-IM against a mid-single-digit FY guide).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: AWC is about a third of revenue. Its InnovaMatrix collapse was absorbed by the guide in 2026; no clean line-specific reaction is available.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Convatec already told the market in August that AWC grows 'ahead of slower markets'. Smith+Nephew's AWC +1.4% confirms the market is slow, but Convatec guided around it, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Coloplast Wound & Tissue Repair +1% organic in Q4 (https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/coloplast-as-announcement-no-112026-202526-full-year-financial-results)

findings.finding: MiniMed, Convatec's largest infusion-set customer and the company behind the MiniMed Flex pump Convatec supplies, reported fiscal Q1 2027 (May-Jul 2026) organic growth of 15.8%, US +13.1%, with CGM and consumables 82% of revenue, and raised its FY guide. That supports the H2 Infusion Care acceleration Convatec guided on 'known customer order phasing'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: IC acceleration is the line H2 depends on. There is no isolated prior reaction to an IC surprise on record.
findings.why_not_priced: It sits inside guidance: Convatec already said it has visibility on H2 IC orders. The data is a counterparty's own, but it predates Convatec's period and is public, so it is sized near 0.
findings.independence: Convatec H1 RNS: 'Customer order phasing in diabetes, with significant visibility on increased H2 revenue' (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/convatec-group--ctec/interim-results-for-6-months-ended-30-june-2026/9702429)

outside_window.finding: Ostomy and urological supplies are in CMS's DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Round 2028, with about 5-6 national contracts. Awards come in 2027 and pricing takes effect 1 Jan 2028. This is a medium-term risk to US CC and OC pricing that will not resolve in this window.

baseline_tension: The negative lean (FY27 margin risk) cuts against the baseline's +2.2 priced_lean (driven by the 4.26% short) and against a +21% rally since 8 Oct. The rally raises the bar for a reiteration, but the squeeze fuel and the positive history of November updates keep p_up near 50 (45).
language_note: Nothing the English sources did not already carry. For the UK the 'local' half is source locality: the RNS record on Investegate supplied the event date (the H1 RNS 'Scheduled events'), the 07:00 release precedent, the flat buyback cadence and the 13 Nov buyback price. The UK retail and adviser press (Sharecast, AJ Bell, HL) carried only republished wire items, and no preview.
lessons_applied: 'A first guide for a new fiscal year is a scheduled guidance event' (median 9.0% when guidance moves): abs_move_pct raised from 6.5 to 7.5. It was not taken to 9, because a reiterated FY26 plus a CMD-consistent FY27 is the likely base case on a 19-analyst FTSE 100 name.
'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': the positive history of November updates (+22.1%, +5.1%) is the reason p_up stays at 45 rather than lower; it did not shrink abs_move.

'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company or a direct counterparty has said it': the oil finding is kept at -1.5 rather than enlarged. The company itself said 'at prevailing price levels' and gave the $20-30m figure, but Coloplast is a peer, not a counterparty.
The findings' sizes are unchanged; expected_move_pct moves only through abs_move (-0.65 to -0.75).
